subject: Phased onramp: acceptance gates, credit swap, and final pricing
messages:
From: Emily Tran <emily.tran@novushealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@novushealth.com>
Date: 2027-07-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff and ask: acceptance criteria + pilot credit top-up

Jordan —

Thanks for the demo yesterday. We want to lock a short Mutual Action Plan so procurement can track acceptance and the commercial milestones. Attached is our first-pass MAP (MAP-Novus-v0.3.xlsx). Key asks from our side:

- Acceptance gates: p95 latency under 200ms for 4k token sequences, success rate > 99%.
- Pilot top-up: Our team needs an additional credit pool (20k inference tokens) to complete the clinical ingestion tests.
- Conversion: If performance meets the gates, we want a pricing commitment with a ramp (months 1–3 at 30% discount, months 4–6 at 20% discount) and an initial minimum commit — but we need flexibility on the initial volume.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can: (1) extend the trial credits through end of Q3 if needed, (2) accept a staged commitment (lower initial commit + ramp), and (3) provide SOC2 evidence and region commitments (we prefer us-west-2)?

Thanks — I can do a quick sync next week.

Emily
Emily Tran
Director, GenAI Programs | Novus Health
Attachments: MAP-Novus-v0.3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 125KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Tran <emily.tran@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-02T11:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and ask: acceptance criteria + pilot credit top-up

Emily — thanks for the clear list and the MAP. Looping Marissa (AE) and Ben (SE) to make the next steps concrete. Quick summary of what we can do and where we need to align: 

1) Trial credit top-up: we can add a one-time incremental credit pool of 20k inference units for the MAP UAT stage. That pool will be tied to the MAP acceptance gates and will expire 90 days after issuance unless converted as part of an accepted term sheet.

2) Acceptance gates: the p95 <200ms target is feasible in our hosted environment in us-west-2 for typical batches if the test harness follows the profile in the MAP. We'll capture baseline numbers this week (Ben will share a short eval report).

3) Pricing & staged commit: Proposed approach — attach a draft term sheet for a staged-commit option (term-sheet-novus-draft.pdf):
   - Month 0 (pilot): credits cover testing.
   - Months 1–3 (onramp): if MAP gates met, customer commits to a minimum committed spend of $25k/month with 30% off list for actual usage against the commit; overage billed at list.
   - Months 4–6: commit steps to $50k/month with 20% off list.

If Novus needs a smaller initial commit we can structure a lower initial anchor + conversion credits that count toward the first month. This will be reflected in the term sheet.

Next steps: Ben will run the acceptance harness and attach results by 7/07; Marissa will own contract coordination and final pricing; I can escalate an SLA exception to Engineering if we need a guaranteed p95 target in a Dedicated environment.

I'll attach the draft term sheet and the MAP update (both attached). Proposed internal approvals deadline: 2027-07-12 to keep procurement on track for signature by 2027-07-14.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: term-sheet-novus-draft.pdf (PDF, 18KB); MAP-Novus-v0.3.xlsx (updated)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Tran <emily.tran@novushealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-05T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and ask: acceptance criteria + pilot credit top-up

Emily + team —

I reviewed the MAP and Jordan's term-sheet draft. A couple of operational clarifications we need to capture before procurement signs: 

- Region: Confirming us-west-2 for the hosted environment. If Novus requires VPC/Private deployment for PHI workflows, that changes the timeline — call that out in the MAP.
- Canary/rollback plan: We need a simple rollback policy in the MAP (if accuracy regression > 3% or latency exceeds SLA for 48h, auto-fallback to previous model variant).
- Credit expiry: Jordan mentioned 90 days; Novus asked for end-of-Q3. If the MAP acceptance window extends beyond 90 days, we can align expiry to the MAP milestone dates (pro-rated).

Ben — can you confirm the expected p50/p95 numbers for the clinical ingestion test and whether prefix caching will affect the gating thresholds?

Marissa Cole
Senior AE | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Emily Tran <emily.tran@novushealth.com>
Date: 2027-07-07T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and ask: acceptance criteria + pilot credit top-up

Emily / Marissa —

Quick technical note from the harness run: baseline numbers attached (eval-results-novus.pdf). Highlights:

- p50: ~45ms for typical 1k tokens; p95: ~180–210ms depending on sequence length distribution. When we enable automatic prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts in the clinical pipeline the p95 drops to ~150–170ms.
- Throughput: we sustained ~220 requests/min at steady state on a single shard with continuous batching.
- Recommendations: run the clinical ingestion phase with the caching flag enabled and a warmup window of 30 minutes prior to the formal acceptance test.

Attachment: eval-results-novus.pdf (PDF, 420KB).

Ben Carter
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Emily Tran <emily.tran@novushealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@novushealth.com>, Novus Health Procurement <procurement@novushealth.com>
Date: 2027-07-09T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and ask: acceptance criteria + pilot credit top-up

Thanks Ben — that helps. A few follow-ups from procurement: 

- Credit expiry: Novus prefers expiry aligned to quarter end (2027-09-30) rather than a 90-day rolling expiry. Can Redwood make that concession for this pilot?
- Initial commit: we cannot commit $25k/month immediately. Can we start at $12k/month for months 1–2 and include a catch-up conversion credit that counts toward month 3? We are comfortable moving to $40–50k/month by month 4 if gates are met.
- SOC2 and docs: procurement needs SOC2 Type II and data retention policy by 7/14.

If Redwood agrees to align credit expiry to 9/30 and accepts the staged commit anchor of $12k/month (with a conversion pathway to $40–50k by month 4), we can sign the MAP and loop legal for redlines next week.

Emily

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Tran <emily.tran@novushealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-14T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Final MAP + term sheet (v0.4) + DocuSign link

Emily —

Thanks for the clear asks. We've incorporated Novus' feedback and are prepared to move forward with the following commercial and operational commitments: 

1) Pilot credits: Redwood will issue a one-time 20k inference-unit top-up that will be valid through 2027-09-30.
2) Acceptance gates: use caching-enabled harness; p95 target for the MAP defined as <=200ms post-warmup, with the documented fallback policy.
3) Staged commit/pricing: initial anchor at $12k/month for months 1–2; if gates met, month 3 conversion credit will be applied to reach an effective $25k/month equivalent for months 1–3; target $40–50k/month by month 4 per mutual ramp notes. Exact mechanics are in the attached term-sheet v0.4.
4) Compliance: SOC2 Type II report and data retention summary linked here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B-novus/compliance (copied to legal). Please expect the SOC2 packet by 2027-07-13 (we have it ready).

Attached: MAP-Novus-v0.4.xlsx (updated MAP), term-sheet-novus-v0.4.pdf.

If that matches Novus' expectations, please sign via the DocuSign link below and we'll convert the credits and schedule the formal acceptance window.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/novus/DEAL-14829

Best —
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP-Novus-v0.4.xlsx (spreadsheet, 210KB); term-sheet-novus-v0.4.pdf (PDF, 22KB)
